|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster raises deploy from 1 to 3. Both keep power 2, ability 2, forfeit 4 and the Warrior icon. The movement prohibition expressly names the same site in the remaster, and the usual single Restricted Access deployment and Interrupt search remain.
